Looking at this sequence, I need to find the pattern.

**Identifying the pattern:**

Starting from -8, each term appears to be the **floor** of the previous term divided by 2:

| Step | Calculation | Result |
|------|------------|--------|
| 1 | -8 | -8 |
| 2 | ⌊-8/2⌋ | -4 |
| 3 | ⌊-4/2⌋ | -2 |
| 4 | ⌊-2/2⌋ | -1 |
| 5 | ⌊-1/2⌋ = ⌊-0.5⌋ | -1 |
| 6 | ⌊-1/2⌋ | -1 |
| 7 | ⌊-1/2⌋ | -1 |
| 8 | ⌊-1/2⌋ | **-1** |

Once the value reaches -1, floor division by 2 keeps it at -1 indefinitely (since ⌊-0.5⌋ = -1).

<answer>-1</answer>
